conventions.convention: The background is a smooth oriented, time-oriented Lorentzian four-manifold without boundary, with signature (-,+,+,+). The manifold orientation is independent of the time orientation. Fields are smooth real two-forms; the inherited tangent-bundle construction assumes Countable Choice.

In length-coordinate charts x⁰=ct, metric components are dimensionless and F_ab has tesla units. Positive symbolic inputs c, G and μ₀ define ε₀=1/(μ₀c²), κ=8πG/c⁴, α=√(κ/(2μ₀)) and ℱ=αF. These inputs assert no measured numerical values.
Curvature is R(X,Y)Z=∇_X∇_YZ−∇_Y∇_XZ−∇_[X,Y]Z, with R(∂_c,∂_d)∂_b=R^a_bcd∂_a, Ric_bd=R^a_bad, S=g^bd Ric_bd and G_ab=Ric_ab−Sg_ab/2.
Positive conformal factors preserve the supplied orientation. The Lorentzian Hodge operator is characterized by α∧⋆β=⟨α,β⟩vol_g, has ⋆²=−id on two-forms, and obeys ⋆_(Ω²g)=Ω^(4−2k)⋆_g on k-forms.
The residual estimate uses the maximum of chart-component suprema on compact K. For nonnegative component functions the empty-set supremum is assigned zero, so the empty restriction has norm zero.
The Coulomb calculation is on r>0, with signed charge Q_e and F_0r=−Q_e/(4πε₀cr²). The origin is excluded; no distributional source or coupled point-source solution is asserted.

load_bearing.statement: For positive c, G and μ₀, define ε₀=1/(μ₀c²), κ=8πG/c⁴, α=√(κ/(2μ₀)), ℱ=αF, m_geo=GM_p/c², q_geo=√(G/(4πε₀c⁴))Q_e, a_geo=J_ang/(M_pc), and p_geo=αΦ_B/(4π), with M_p>0 and the stated SI units.

For the same smooth Lorentzian metric and two-form, with Q_ab(g,F)=F_ac F_b^c−g_ab F_cd F^cd/4 and constant real Λ, the equations G_ab+Λg_ab=(κ/μ₀)Q_ab(g,F), G_ab+Λg_ab=2Q_ab(g,ℱ), and Ric_ab−Λg_ab=2Q_ab(g,ℱ) are equivalent.

For smooth positive dimensionless Ω and the same orientation, (F,j) satisfies dF=0 and d(⋆_gF)=μ₀ι_j vol_g if and only if (F,Ω⁻⁴j) satisfies the same equations for Ω²g. The lower and upper stress tensors scale by Ω⁻² and Ω⁻⁶ respectively, and the quadratic action density is unchanged.

For smooth positive Ω, put u=Ω⁻¹dΩ, H_ab=(∇_a u)_b, θ=g^ab H_ab and s=g^ab u_a u_b. Then H is symmetric, Ric̃_ab=Ric_ab−2H_ab−g_abθ+2u_a u_b−2g_abs, S̃=Ω⁻²(S−6θ−6s), and G̃_ab=G_ab−2H_ab+2u_a u_b+2g_abθ+g_abs.

published_dependencies.used_for: Exact inherited assumption that every countable family of nonempty sets admits a choice function; no additional full Choice is asserted.
Smooth boundaryless four-manifold, Lorentzian signature, time orientation and coordinate conventions underlying the conformal calculations.
Torsion freedom, metric compatibility, intrinsic Levi–Civita construction and Christoffel formula used in conformal and constant-rescaling proofs.
Curvature sign, component order, Ricci contraction, scalar curvature and Einstein tensor definitions.
Existence and uniqueness of the connection for either conformally related metric; covariant derivative of the connection-difference tensor, contraction compatibility and ∇g=0.
Exact coordinate curvature formula used to derive the conformal curvature difference.
Differentiation of compositions with positive conformal factors.
Derivatives and locally reconstructed smoothness of reciprocal powers and square-root normalizers.
Smoothness of finite component operations and compositions, applied for every finite derivative order.
Oriented metric volume and the current three-form ι_j vol_g, through the Lorentzian-form supplier.
Independent manifold orientation and positively oriented charts.
Smooth differential forms as sections of exterior powers of the cotangent bundle.

concerns.concern: The opening says “Let g,F,j,Λ,c,G,μ₀,κ be as in [[def-emg-geometric-scaling]]”, but that definition introduces neither j nor Λ. The intended smooth-vector-field type for j and constant-real type for Λ are available in the cited Maxwell and normalization theorems, respectively. Correct the attribution or state those types locally; the rescaling calculation itself is sound.

alerts.finding: The Remarks say “the single negative direction contributes ε_Iε_(I^c)=−1 in step 2.1.” That product and the star-square calculation occur in step 2.2; step 2.1 establishes smoothness and patching. The mathematical formula is correct, but the proof locator is wrong.

seams_checked.note: Checked the page descriptions against the Lorentzian-form definition and Hodge lemmas, and their actual uses in the assigned items. Dimension, signature, independent orientation, smoothness, Countable Choice and the conformal Hodge multiplier are preserved. No global tetrad, global potential or physical field law is inferred.

Opened thm-qft-conformal-external-scalar. Its F3 quotes S̃=Ω⁻²(S−6θ−6s) with the supplier's definitions and curvature convention. Step 1.1 specializes to flat η and explicitly cancels the gradient-square terms to obtain R_g=−6Ω⁻³□_ηΩ. The consumer retains smooth positivity, dimension four, Countable Choice and conditional draft-supplier status, and asserts no Einstein equation or backreaction.
